lead.body: Overnight ballistic missiles strike the Podilskyi, Darnytskyi and Pivdennyi bridges, the biggest attack on the capital's river crossings since the war began. Three killed, power cut in five districts.
lead.headline: Russia hits three Kyiv bridges, killing three

panels.body: Japan's Nikkei falls 4.8% on Friday; Anthropic's record debut fails to stop the AI rout. The S&P 500 falls a fifth day in a row.
panels.headline: Asian stocks tumble as AI sell-off deepens

panels.body: European leaders dismiss the three leaders' 'peace declaration' as a photo op; it says nothing on Ukraine or Iran.
panels.headline: Europe dismisses 'peace declaration' as photo op

panels.body: A day after a missile damaged the PIF Tower, Saudi air defences destroy four ballistic missiles aimed at the south.
panels.headline: Houthi attacks on Riyadh go on; four missiles downed

panels.body: A day after the world court found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, its government dismisses the verdict.
panels.headline: Myanmar calls ICJ genocide ruling 'unfair'

panels.body: Negotiators in Antalya strip any call to end fossil fuels from the draft deal as the summit enters its final day.
panels.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel phase-out

panels.body: The late baseball star is cleared decades after a lifetime ban for betting on games. Trump announces the pardon overnight.
panels.headline: Trump pardons Pete Rose posthumously

ticker: UK-EU summit on youth mobility - Bukele seeks third term - Putin vows Kerch Bridge retaliation - Prabowo meets Xi - Poland lifts air warning - Fiona the hippo dies
